source(output(
		Claim_Line as integer,
		Line_Charge as string,
		Plan_Paid as string,
		Service_Date as string,
		Member_Responsibility as string,
		Covered_Units as string,
		Allowed_Amount as string,
		Revenue_Code as string,
		Claim_ID as string,
		Billed_Units as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  DISTINCT [Claim_ID]       ,CAST([Claim_Line] AS INT) AS Claim_Line       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Revenue_Code])) AS Revenue_Code       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Service_Date])) AS Service_Date       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Billed_Units])) AS Billed_Units       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Line_Charge])) AS Line_Charge       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Allowed_Amount])) AS Allowed_Amount       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Member_Responsibility])) AS Member_Responsibility       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Plan_Paid])) AS Plan_Paid       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Covered_Units])) AS Covered_Units    FROM [EXTRACT].[FL_3M_Inpatient_Claim_Line]   ORDER BY [Claim_ID],CAST([Claim_Line] AS INT)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceInPatientLine
SourceInPatientLine sink(input(
		Claim_Line as string,
		Line_Charge as decimal(0,0),
		Plan_Paid as decimal(0,0),
		Service_Date as string,
		Member_Responsibility as decimal(0,0),
		Covered_Units as integer,
		Allowed_Amount as decimal(0,0),
		Revenue_Code as string,
		Claim_ID as string,
		Billed_Units as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Claim_Line,
		Line_Charge,
		Plan_Paid,
		Service_Date,
		Member_Responsibility,
		Covered_Units,
		Allowed_Amount,
		Revenue_Code,
		Claim_ID,
		Billed_Units)) ~> TargetInPatientLine
